feature: The net maps' own pieces on generated layers
name: The Aquarium's animated tiles are bubbles, not fish
result: With the pillars cut whole from Aquarium Comp's maps and set under a generated layer's pads, the two animated blocks (tiles 1-6 and 7-12) sit under the pillars' stubs and show bubbles rising, different from frame to frame; the fish seen beside them are the backdrop's, there before the pillars were set.
meaning: The first probe set the blocks alone over the backdrop and read its fish as theirs: a piece is judged where its map sets it. The scripts' addresses and tile numbers stand.
